units.text: Apple and The King’s Trust announced today an expansion of their partnership with a new education program that offers workshops to help young people build creative and digital skills. Here are the details.
Apple’s partnership with The King’s Trust dates back to 2019

In a Newsroom post published today, Apple and The King’s Trust announced the “Apple x King’s Trust Creative Labs” initiative, which will “offer young people meaningful engagement with Apple experts across industries as they explore a variety of career pathways, equipping them with the technology, resources, skills, confidence, and expertise needed to realize their potential.”
According to Apple, the program’s immersive educational experience began earlier this week with “music industry and creative workshops, aligned to the recent opening of Apple Music Hall.”
Apple says the first cohort will include up to 20 participants aged 18 to 30, with additional sessions and cohorts planned over the next year.
Here’s Alisha Johnson Wilder, Apple’s senior director of Global Community Impact, on what the initiative means for Apple and its partnership with The King’s Trust:

“At Apple, we believe education is a powerful force for equity and opportunity. […] For years, we’ve been proud to work alongside The King’s Trust to spark creativity and open doors for young people across the UK. With the launch of the Apple x King’s Trust Creative Labs, we’re taking that commitment further, connecting the next generation of creators and innovators directly with our experts, technology, and mentorship to help them build vital skills, discover their passions, and thrive in the workforce.”

Jonathan Townsend, The King’s Trust’s UK chief executive, also commented on the initiative, calling it “an exciting new chapter in our partnership that will help even more young people develop the confidence and creative digital skills they need to take their next steps toward employment.”
In the announcement, Apple said it is also working with The King’s Trust on resources to improve AI literacy and help educators incorporate new technologies into their teaching.
To read Apple’s full announcement, follow this link.

units.text: Beginning with the U.S. Grand Prix weekend on Friday, October 23, Apple TV will offer Formula 1 coverage in Dolby Atmos on supported devices. Here are the details.
’Bringing exceptional picture and sound together to capture the full intensity of the sport’

Apple and Dolby Laboratories announced a new partnership to bring Dolby Atmos to Apple TV’s live Formula 1 coverage, starting with the U.S. Grand Prix weekend, which begins October 23 in Austin, Texas.

Apple says Dolby Atmos will join “Dolby Vision to deliver an even more immersive viewing experience,” putting “fans at the heart of the action, surrounding them with the energy, drama, and emotion of Formula 1.”

From team radio communications and race commentary to the roar of the engines, on-track battles, and the intensity of the pit lane, Dolby Atmos brings the unmistakable sounds that define the sport to life.
Here’s Oliver Schusser, Vice President of Apple Music and International Content at Apple, on the announcement:

“We’re always looking for new ways to make Formula 1 on Apple TV even better for fans. […] The sound of Formula 1 is such an important part of what makes the sport so exciting, and with Dolby Atmos joining Dolby Vision, fans can experience the energy and intensity of every Grand Prix in a whole new way. It’s another example of how we’re continuing to innovate across the viewing experience to bring fans closer to the action.”
It’s worth noting that Apple TV’s streaming rights for Formula 1 still include only the U.S., but don’t require an extra subscription on top of the Apple TV subscription.

Apple recently made the Bahrain Grand Prix available to stream for free in the U.S., and has also partnered with Netflix to bring Formula 1: Drive to Survive Season 8 to Apple TV in the U.S. As part of the same collaboration, the 2026 Canadian Grand Prix was streamed live on both Apple TV and Netflix in the U.S.

Apple secured the U.S. streaming rights to Formula 1 in 2025 as part of a five-year deal beginning with the 2026 season, and has previously indicated it wants to expand its F1 coverage into additional markets.
Apple’s broader relationship with Formula 1 also includes “F1: The Movie,” which won the Academy Award for Best Sound earlier this year and remains Apple’s biggest theatrical success to date.
Apple TV is available for $14.99 per month or as part of the Apple One bundle. It features hit TV shows and movies like Ted Lasso, Severance, The Studio, The Morning Show, Shrinking, and Silo.

units.text: Following a report from Bloomberg yesterday that Apple is collaborating with LG for a new collection of smart home devices and accessories, a reliable leaker known as “pdfu” on X has revealed more details about several of the new products, including a thermostat with a “Far Sight Display” that sounds similar to what Nest offers. Specifics about pricing and availability aren’t yet known, but the devices will reportedly integrate with Apple’s rumored smart home hub that’s expected to launch on October 13th.
[Media: https://twitter.com/itspdfu/status/2107818768827052305]

The LG Smart Deadbolt Lock will feature a keypad that “rotates to open” and an adjustable design ensuring that rotating parts don’t end up touching a nearby wall. Functionality includes automatic unlocking, tap to unlock, emergency power, adjustable light settings, and an alarm for when the door has been left open or unlocked. In addition to access codes and remote operability, the deadbolt lock will also include a pair of mechanical keys that can be used as a backup.
[Media: https://twitter.com/itspdfu/status/2107818771213664728?s=20]

The LG Smart Thermostat appears to feature a streamlined circular design with a large display for the current temperature and other measurements like humidity. Settings include adjustments for its “Far Sight Display,” brightness, and “calibrated temperature/temperature offset.” To help ensure an entire home is properly heated or cooled, an accompanying LG Temperature Sensor that can also measure humidity can be installed, providing the thermostat with measurements for other rooms. The sensor features a magnetic back for attaching to metal surfaces, an adhesive metal plate for more installation flexibility, and a replaceable battery with alerts when it needs a swap.
[Media: https://twitter.com/itspdfu/status/2107818774107967561]

units.text: Apple has a fully redesigned MacBook Pro launching soon, its first new design since 2021. Here are three design changes reportedly coming.
#1: No notch
One of the defining traits of the current MacBook Pro design is its display cutout: the notch.

The MacBook Pro introduced the notch to the Mac line in 2021, and the redesigned model that’s about to launch will reportedly remove it. Instead, the new MacBook Pro will have a small camera cutout and Dynamic Island built in. Per Mark Gurman:
The Dynamic Island on the Mac will be built around a hole-punch-sized cutout for the computer’s camera. It’s smaller than the pill-shaped notch in current iPhones.
It sounds like the notch replacement could be similar to iPhone Duo’s hole-punch camera on its outer display.
#2: Thinner and lighter
The current MacBook Pro is a hefty powerhouse, but Apple reportedly has a thinner, lighter design coming for the new MacBook Pro. Per Bloomberg earlier this week:
The new MacBook Pros are lighter — significantly lighter. Apple has reengineered the machine’s interior miniaturizing parts and rearranging components to make the computer much easier to carry.

It’s unknown whether slimming the MacBook Pro will result in any ports being removed. Apple’s current MacBook Pro design brought back many ports that had been removed in the prior iteration. It would be surprising for the company to strip ports yet again.
#3: Slightly larger displays
An Omdia report this summer said the redesigned MacBook Pro will come in two screen sizes:
14.3 inches
16.3 inches
If accurate, this is a very slight increase over the current 14.2- and 16.2-inch sizes. It’s possible Apple will reduce the bezels a bit to achieve a larger usable display area.

It’s also possible that the overall form factor will get slightly larger to help provide extra space for components despite the thinner body. But there are no specific rumors around these details yet.
What interests you most about the redesigned MacBook Pro? Let us know in the comments.

evidence.discovery_lead: When iOS 27 was released, a legit advertising company found it could no longer serve ads to the Safari browser. This block appears to be a mistake on Apple's side, but the ad industry is up in arms about the implications. At least one ad agency was initially blocked in Safari when iOS 27 was launched. Apple introduced App Tracking Transparency back in 2021 in order that users had to choose to allow ad companies to track them using identifiers. After a heavy initial impact , though, the rates of users allowing tracking has risen again , and advertisers have found alternative ways to learn about users. However, according to advertising trade journal AdExchanger , The Trade Desk ad agency was blocked in iOS 27 by Apple itself. It appears that Apple is intentionally blocking data brokers who sell on tracked data, but in doing so it prevented The Trade Desk serving ads. units.text: 10月7日，据投资网站Investing.com报道，苹果前CEO、执行董事长Tim Cook(Tim Cook)在今年10月2日出售了总价值约6380万美元(约合4.3亿元人民币)的普通股。
库克
这些股票的出售价格介于每股331.44美元至333.94美元之间，接近苹果目前332.89美元的股价，也接近345.34美元的52周高点。
库克此次售股发生在10月1日374541股限制性股票单位(RSU)结算之后，这些RSU转换成了数量相等的普通股。苹果扣留了199038股，按每股330.32美元计算，价值65746232美元，用于覆盖与RSU归属相关的代扣税义务。此次RSU归属取决于苹果相对于标普500指数的三年期股东总回报表现，苹果的排名位于第76.20百分位。
库克在10月2日的这笔股票出售是根据10b5-1规则交易计划执行的，他在2026年5月28日制定了该计划。此外，库克在10月2日通过赠与的方式处置了26325股股票。
这些交易完成后，库克通过其信托实益持有3237843股苹果普通股。

units.text: Update, October 7: Apple has now released both RCs to public beta testers as well. The build numbers are unchanged from the developer RCs.
In addition to releasing macOS 27.2 Golden Gate public beta 2, Apple is now rolling out the first Release Candidates of macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2. Here are the details.
Security updates continue for older macOS versions

As is usually the case for point updates of older macOS versions, Apple today rolled out the first release candidates of macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2, without first releasing regular beta versions.
Apple released macOS Sequoia 15.8.1 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.1 late last month, both of which saw two RCs before the official rollout.

Apple’s release notes for the first macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 RCs mention only that they “provide[s] important security fixes and [are] recommended for all users.” Last month’s updates contained a single CoreGraphics security fix, with its details reading:

Processing a maliciously crafted file may lead to arbitrary code execution. Apple is aware of a report that this issue may have been exploited in an extremely sophisticated attack against specific targeted individuals on versions of iOS before iOS 27.

Apple will likely detail the fixes included in macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 after their official release, which will likely come alongside macOS 27.2 Golden Gate within the next few weeks.
The release build for macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 RC 1 is 24H219, while the release build for macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 RC 1 is 25G320.
Did you spot anything new or different in today’s RCs? Let us know in the comments.

Affected users complain of a burning sensation and redness under the sensor area. The Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4 measure heart rate every five seconds, and some people have wondered if that's the cause of the skin irritation. Along with more frequent heart rate readings, the Series 12 and Ultra 4 have a larger ECG electrode surface, photodiodes in a ring-shaped arrangement, and larger green LEDs. It is unknown if any of these design changes are a problem, but wrist irritation from the Apple Watch is a complaint that dates back to the original model. Apple says reactions can be caused by wearing a band too tight or too loose, or by irritants like soap and sweat under the watch. Some Apple Watch models contain nickel, but it is a low amount below EU limits, and Apple says it's unlikely to be a problem. The Apple Watch case and certain Apple Watch bands have trace amounts of acrylates and methacrylates from adhesives, but Apple says it designs the watch and bands to keep those components away from skin. Apple recommends making sure a band fits well and keeping the Apple Watch, bands, and skin clean and dry. Apple adds that cleaning may be required after workouts or exposure to liquids like sweat, soap, sunscreen, and lotion. Some users have seen the issue clear up after an adjustment period wearing the watch, and cleaning the back of the watch and the band has also helped in some cases. Other users have returned their devices. Apple advises that users experiencing redness, swelling, itchiness, or other irritation consult a physician before putting the watch back on. iPhone Duo launches October 23 running iOS 27.1. And all indications are that no other iPhones will get that update, instead jumping straight to 27.2.

When will iOS 27.2 launch? We know it is coming in October.

units.text: A new report from Counterpoint Research shows that Apple overtook Samsung during the second quarter of 2026 to become the leading smartphone brand in Europe’s carrier channel, as operator sales held up better than the broader market. Here are the details.
Apple helps carrier sales outperform broader European smartphone market

In a report published today, Counterpoint Research says smartphone sales through carriers in Europe declined 4% year-over-year in Q2 2026, compared with an 11% drop in the open market. Total smartphone sales, per the report, declined 8%.

Apple was a key driver of this shift, having overtaken Samsung as the market share leader of Europe’s operator channel. Motorola and vivo also contributed to the growth with some strategic positioning with key European operators.

Counterpoint says this is yet another result of rising memory costs, which have hit Europe’s low-end smartphone market particularly hard. Carrier sales, meanwhile, have held up better because they tend to skew toward higher-end devices and premium brands such as Apple, with more phones purchased on contract.
According to the report, Apple’s share of smartphone sales through European carriers rose from 33% in Q2 2025 to 37% in Q2 2026, while Samsung’s fell from 39% to 34% over the same period.
That said, Chinese brand vivo posted the biggest year-over-year increase in carrier sales, at 90%, while Motorola came in a distant second with 27% growth.
Here’s Jan Stryjak, Associate Director at Counterpoint Research, on these numbers:

“Smartphone sales through operators in Europe are typically more high-end than through the open market, as more are purchased on a contract. They are also more skewed towards more premium brands like Apple, Samsung, and Google. The collapse of the low-end of the smartphone market so far in 2026 because of the memory price crisis has therefore benefitted the operator channel, which has declined comparatively less than the open market.”

Stryjak added that he expects the carrier channel to continue gaining share over the “next few quarters as the lower end of the market continues to be impacted by the memory crisis.” He also noted that independent retailers have increased promotional activity compared to carriers, “which could mitigate some of the price rises and provide addition [sic] stimulus to the open market.”

units.text: watchOS 27 is the latest major software update for Apple Watch, and among its variety of new features, it adds three new apps to your Watch.
#1: Siri
Siri just got a major AI overhaul in watchOS 27, and one part of that is a brand new Siri app.
The Siri app is available across iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Vision Pro, and also the Apple Watch.
watchOS 27 still lets you invoke Siri via the Digital Crown, but the app is another place you can go to start a conversation. Perhaps more importantly, the app is where you can browse past ones.

Siri AI is more conversational than the old assistant, and keeps a record of past queries across all your devices. So the Siri app in watchOS 27 shows you conversations not just from your Apple Watch, but from your iPhone, Mac, and more.
#2: Find My
Joining iOS 27’s new features for the Find My app, Apple has rethought the Find My experience in watchOS this year too.
In watchOS 26, Find My was split up into three separate apps: Find Devices, Find Items, and Find People.
But in watchOS 27, Apple has streamlined all finding features into a new, unified ‘Find My’ app.
Find My on Apple Watch provides all the functionality of the previous three apps, but in a condensed experience so you can easily locate anything or anyone on a map-centric view.
You can switch between different things you’re looking for via a menu in the top-left corner, but otherwise you’ll see a consistent interface.
#3: Readiness
If you own an Apple Watch Series 12 or Apple Watch Ultra 4, watchOS 27 also adds a third app: Readiness.
Here’s what the Readiness app does, per the App Store:
The Readiness app analyzes your recent activity, vitals, and sleep to help you understand your capacity to take on the day.
Features
Get a score and a clear classification of your readiness, including Recover, Pace Yourself, Ready, or Go For It.
See an explanation of relevant factors and tap through to associated apps.
Add complications and Smart Stack widgets for convenient and glanceable insights.
View additional details in the Fitness app on iPhone.
Essentially, Readiness provides you a quick glimpse into your overall vitals so you know how well rested and ready your body may be on a given day.

该机构认为运营商渠道因合约机占比高、高端机型集中，受内存成本上涨冲击较小，此外高端品牌在运营商渠道的销售韧性更强。

units.text: Apple and other tech giants may have to pay an annual lump sum to the EU under a modified version of a digital services tax plan.
The EU hopes a revised version of earlier proposals will enable it to raise tax revenues without incurring the wrath of the White House …
There has long been debate within EU countries about taxes on digital services, with Apple examples including iCloud, Apple Music, Apple TV, Apple Creator Studio, and more.

Some point to the significant revenues earned from selling subscription services to EU citizens without necessarily paying any tax in Europe on these receipts. Others are concerned that a digital tax could disproportionately hit European companies, while yet others are concerned about threatened retaliation by the White House for additional taxes on US companies.

The Financial Times reports that the European Commission has now come up with a compromise it hopes will keep everybody happy – other than the companies like Apple, Google and Meta who would be paying the new taxes, of course.

Brussels was considering changes to an existing proposal that would require all companies operating in the EU with revenue of more than €100mn a year to pay an annual lump-sum tax contribution, the officials said […]

Adjusting the thresholds and contributions under the Core proposal to cover only very large corporates would both increase the amount raised from tech groups and defuse criticism in Europe that Core would hit many medium-sized European companies, officials argued.

The revised version of the plan would not single out companies selling digital services, but would apply to all large corporations. Since it was the former proposal that led the White House to threaten retaliatory tariffs, the EU hopes that the new version won’t provoke a new trade war with the US.
View all comments
The amount that would be levied on each company has not yet been decided. The plan is to seek agreement on the principle across the 27 EU countries before setting a rate for the tax.
9to5Mac’s Take

This whole mess was supposed to have been resolved by a global agreement, brokered by the Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD). This would have ensured that all companies worldwide pay at least some taxes in each of the countries in which they operate, and the plan had Apple’s support.
However, Donald Trump withdrew the US from this agreement, leading to calls for an EU-specific version. The idea that Trump won’t object to the revised plan seems to me rather optimistic.

units.text: 快科技10月8日消息，据MacRumors报道，近日，部分Apple Watch Series 12和Apple Watch Ultra 4用户反映，佩戴新款手表后出现皮肤不适，手腕与传感器接触的位置出现发红、灼烧感等症状。
据了解，相关反馈出现在论坛和Reddit社区，多名用户表示，皮肤不适主要集中在手表背部传感器与手腕接触的区域。
其中，一名Apple Watch Series 12用户称，佩戴新手表后，传感器接触的位置持续出现轻微灼烧感，直到摘下手表充电时，才发现手腕已经发红。
该用户强调，自己并未将表带系得过紧或过松，也保持了手腕和手表背部的清洁，手表本身也没有出现发热情况。
值得注意的是，Apple Watch Series 12和Ultra 4均对健康传感器进行了升级，心率监测频率提高至每5秒测量一次。
与此同时，新款手表还扩大了心电图电极的接触面积，将光电二极管改为环形排列，并采用尺寸更大的绿色LED灯。
部分用户怀疑，这些传感器方面的变化可能与皮肤不适有关，但目前尚无证据证明两者存在直接联系，具体原因仍不明确。
事实上，Apple Watch出现类似皮肤刺激问题并非首次，早在初代Apple Watch上市时，就曾有用户反映佩戴后出现皮肤不适。
根据苹果官方支持文档，佩戴Apple Watch后出现皮肤不适，可能与表带松紧不合适、皮肤过敏，以及汗液、肥皂等刺激物长时间接触皮肤有关。
苹果指出，表带过紧可能刺激皮肤，过松则容易产生摩擦，因此佩戴时应保持适当松紧，让皮肤能够正常透气。
苹果建议，用户应保持手表、表带及皮肤清洁干燥，尤其在运动出汗或接触肥皂、防晒霜等物质后，应及时清洁。

units.text: 苹果正在加速进军智能家居市场，而与LG Electronics合作开发的一系列新品也首次出现了较为完整的实物设计信息。根据美国联邦通信委员会（FCC）提交的文件以及相关技术报告，LG正在为苹果即将推出的智能家居生态打造至少7款配件，其中包括智能恒温器、温度传感器、智能门锁、有线视频门铃、室内摄像头、室外摄像头和泛光灯摄像头。苹果虽然没有出现在这些监管文件中，但此前彭博社已经报道称，苹果参与了这些产品的设计、功能规划和工程开发。
此次曝光的三款产品分别是智能恒温器TMCTAW5W、温度传感器TMST2A6W以及智能门锁TMCDD15G/TMCDD15S。FCC文件不仅提供了产品外壳和标签布局图，还公开了部分技术测试资料，因此外界首次能够较为具体地了解苹果和LG正在打造的智能家居硬件。
智能恒温器采用圆形“圆盘”造型，机身边缘略微隆起，整体设计相当简洁。产品背面中央设有电源接口，下方还有两个圆形结构。它使用24V交流电供电，背面中央印有Matter标志和二维码设置代码，周围则环绕着监管信息。内部接线端子被布置在两组弧形区域中。
从无线连接能力来看，这款恒温器支持2.4GHz和5GHz Wi-Fi、蓝牙以及Thread，同时还内置60GHz雷达。后者尤其值得关注，因为60GHz雷达可以用于检测人员是否靠近设备。
根据爆料者“pdfu”披露的信息，恒温器还具备所谓“Far Sight Display”远距离显示模式，可以显示湿度信息，并提供屏幕亮度和语言设置。用户还可以对温度进行校准，或者设置温度偏移量，从而解决恒温器测量位置与实际室内体感温度之间可能存在的差异。
第二款产品是圆形温度传感器，型号为TMST2A6W。它使用一枚3V CR2477纽扣电池供电，背面印有产品名称、型号以及制造信息。中央区域包含Matter配网代码、电池警告标识和UL认证标志。
这款传感器支持蓝牙低功耗和Thread无线连接，可以同时检测温度和湿度。其背面带有磁性结构，可以直接吸附在金属表面；如果需要安装在其他材质表面，则可以使用随附的带胶金属安装板。电池可以更换，并且设备能够在电池需要更换时发出提醒。
第三款产品则是智能门锁。此次曝光的型号包括TMCDD15G和TMCDD15S，分别对应石墨色和银色版本。门锁内侧采用较高的纵向机身设计，上下两端呈弧形，中间则保持较为平直的结构。
门锁使用4节AA电池供电，电池以垂直方式并排安装在机身上半部分。下方则是一块尺寸较大的旋转圆形结构，几乎占据整个下半部。Matter配网代码和监管信息位于电池仓上方。
这款门锁的无线功能相当丰富，同时支持蓝牙、Thread、NFC和UWB超宽带技术。其中最值得注意的是UWB。FCC相关文件显示，门锁可以首先通过蓝牙验证兼容设备的访问凭证，然后利用UWB确定设备与门锁之间的距离和位置，在满足条件后执行开锁操作。这比单纯依靠蓝牙信号判断距离更加精确，也进一步解释了此前报道中的“靠近自动解锁”功能。
根据相关爆料，门锁的数字键盘可以旋转打开，随产品附带的旋转销还可以限制其活动方向，避免键盘在打开时撞到附近的墙壁。门锁还提供触摸面板灯环控制、“门未关提醒”以及锁具声音音量调节等设置。
功能方面，这款门锁据称支持自动解锁、点击解锁、紧急供电以及主密码，并随机附带两把机械钥匙。它可以适配60.3毫米和69.9毫米两种规格的门锁安装尺寸，因此能够覆盖相当一部分传统住宅门锁的安装环境。
这三款产品都采用Matter生态体系，这一点对于苹果的智能家居战略非常重要。Matter的意义在于让不同厂商的智能家居设备能够在统一标准下协同工作，而Thread则可以作为低功耗、低延迟的本地网络连接方式。对于苹果而言，这意味着未来这些LG设备不仅可以成为单独运行的智能家居产品，也有望成为Apple Home生态中的组成部分。
值得注意的是，苹果并不会亲自生产这些设备。监管文件显示，相关产品将由LG负责生产并以LG品牌销售，而苹果则参与产品设计、功能规划和工程开发。这种合作模式可以让苹果快速扩张Home生态，同时避免自己承担大量硬件生产、库存、售后和供应链管理成本。
这实际上与苹果过去和LG的合作方式存在一定相似之处。苹果此前曾与LG合作推出面向Mac用户的UltraFine 4K和5K显示器。LG同时也是苹果重要的显示面板供应商。2024年，LG还收购了智能家居平台Homey母公司Athom的80%股份，这可能进一步增强其进入智能家居硬件市场的能力。
从目前曝光的产品线来看，苹果显然不满足于推出一个单独的智能家居控制中心。LG负责的7款产品已经覆盖家庭温控、环境监测、门锁、门铃以及室内外安全监控等多个领域。如果这些产品最终能够与苹果的Home应用、Siri以及即将推出的智能家居中枢深度结合，苹果实际上是在尝试建立一套完整的家庭硬件生态。
苹果目前正在准备自己的智能家居控制中心。传闻中的产品拥有约6英寸方形屏幕，既有壁挂版本，也有类似iMac G4设计的桌面版本，可以用于控制家庭设备、进行FaceTime视频通话、查看天气和日历、播放照片以及运行其他家庭信息功能。该设备预计采用A18或更高规格芯片，并支持Apple Intelligence和新一代Siri。
苹果预计将在10月13日发布新的智能家居产品，包括这款全新的家庭控制中心、Apple TV 4K和新一代HomePod mini。不过，LG生产的这批智能家居配件预计不会同步上市，而是还需要几个月时间才能正式推出。
值得特别说明的是，LG的摄像头产品并不等同于苹果自己的智能家庭摄像头。彭博社最新消息显示，苹果仍在单独开发自己的家庭安全摄像头和传感器产品，两者与LG的产品完全不同。苹果自研方案预计在2027年推出，重点强调隐私保护，并计划利用AI分析家庭环境，而不是持续录制视频。
从整体战略来看，苹果似乎正在采取一种与过去完全不同的智能家居扩张方式。苹果负责核心平台、软件、人工智能和产品设计，LG等合作伙伴则负责大量具体硬件产品的生产和支持。这样既可以保持苹果生态系统的一致性，又可以迅速扩大产品覆盖范围。
如果最终形成目前曝光的完整产品阵容，苹果未来的Home生态将不再只是HomePod、Apple TV和第三方HomeKit设备的组合，而可能逐渐发展成为覆盖门锁、恒温器、环境传感器、门铃以及家庭安全监控的一整套硬件体系。对于长期落后于亚马逊Ring、GoogleNest以及三星SmartThings等竞争对手的苹果来说，这可能是其智能家居战略真正开始发力的重要信号。

units.text: Apple and The King’s Trust are building on their longstanding partnership by launching an immersive new education program to help young people build careers in the creative industries. The Apple x King’s Trust Creative Labs will offer young people meaningful engagement with Apple experts across industries as they explore a variety of career pathways, equipping them with the technology, resources, skills, confidence, and expertise needed to realize their potential. A first cohort of up to 20 young people ages 18 to 30 will join specialized workshops to learn valuable, industry-aligned skills using Apple technologies. The immersive educational experience began this week with music industry and creative workshops, aligned to the recent opening of Apple Music Hall at Battersea Power Station in London, with more sessions and cohorts to come over the course of the next year. Apple has long supported educational programming for learners of all ages and backgrounds in the UK and around the world. Its offerings aim to help participants gain needed skills, access a wide range of resources, and succeed in the workforce. “At Apple, we believe education is a powerful force for equity and opportunity,” said Alisha Johnson Wilder, Apple’s senior director of Global Community Impact. “For years, we’ve been proud to work alongside The King’s Trust to spark creativity and open doors for young people across the UK. With the launch of the Apple x King’s Trust Creative Labs, we’re taking that commitment further, connecting the next generation of creators and innovators directly with our experts, technology, and mentorship to help them build vital skills, discover their passions, and thrive in the workforce.” This year marks the 50th anniversary of The King’s Trust. Since it was founded by His Majesty The King, as the Prince of Wales, in 1976, it has helped 1.3 million young people across the UK reach their potential by developing life skills, preparing for employment, accessing job opportunities, and launching their businesses. At least $15 billion of social value can be attributed directly to the impact of The Trust’s programs over the last 50 years, and many of the participants it has supported over the last five years have moved into work, education, or training. “Together with Apple, we have already opened up valuable opportunities for thousands of young people across the UK through our longstanding partnership,” said Jonathan Townsend, The King’s Trust’s UK chief executive. “We are proud to build on this work with the Creative Labs program, an exciting new chapter in our partnership that will help even more young people develop the confidence and creative digital skills they need to take their next steps toward employment. We cannot wait to see how they use these experiences to realize their potential and discover where their talents can take them.” Since 2019, Apple’s support has enabled The King’s Trust to expand STEAM programming to schools in every region across the country through the Achieve program. Using Apple’s coding education resources, young people work collaboratively and think strategically to develop apps that address the needs and goals of their communities. Additionally, The King’s Trust’s 12-week Team program offers young adults access to Apple technology and learning resources to support their efforts to earn a Personal Development and Employability qualification. Apple is also working with The King’s Trust to develop resources that build AI literacy, creativity, and agency among educators and young people, and to empower educators to thoughtfully integrate the latest technologies within their teaching practices.

units.text: You only have to read some of the comments right here to see that there’s a vocal minority of people rejecting all AI tools, including Apple Intelligence. That’s led to an unofficial tool enabling people to turn off the feature on their Macs and remove all downloaded Siri AI models.
We warned yesterday that this could be a risky thing to do, but it’s now being suggested that Apple may have to officially support an AI removal feature in order to protect hardware sales …

There’s been growing pushback against generative AI in general, with opponents citing reasons ranging from fearing for the survival of the human species down to simply not wanting unwanted AI features to take up storage space on their devices.

The latest Apple Intelligence models can require up to 14GB of storage, so there’s a significant hit to 256GB machines if you don’t want the features. That led indie developer Om Lahore to create a project called RemoveMacAI.
View all comments
We warned yesterday that using this is not without risks. Given how deeply Apple Intelligence is embedded into macOS 27, it could have unwanted impact on even quite basic functionality.

But some are arguing that Apple may have to introduce an official way to remove Apple Intelligence from Macs. Daring Fireball’s John Gruber points to organizations banning the installation of AI tools.

There are institutional groups that have rules against AI — these places aren’t allowing Golden Gate at all until and unless Apple Intelligence can be removed. And that means not buying new Mac hardware that only runs Golden Gate.

To be clear, Apple does offer a great many controls to organizations using device management. Currently, Apple says they can “restrict the use” of certain Apple Intelligence features, and there are individual toggles to enable or disable features one at a time. What’s currently lacking is a single switch to disable all Apple Intelligence features in one hit, together with the option to remove the downloaded models.

It’s not a live issue yet, but as future generations of Macs start dropping support for older versions of macOS, failing to allow the easy removal of AI models could start to hit Apple’s hardware sales.

units.text: IT之家 10 月 8 日消息，开发者 j0sh1x 昨日公布了一项复古硬件移植项目，展示了他在 HTC HD2 上成功运行 iOS 7 的成果，并公开了相关 XNU 内核及硬件支持代码。公开信息显示，该项目目前已经能够让 iOS 用户态组件在 HTC HD2 上运行，触摸屏也已实现工作。
HTC HD2 发布于 2010 年，内部代号 HTC Leo，搭载高通 QSD8250 处理器。此次项目并非通过模拟器运行 iOS，而是针对 HTC HD2 的硬件平台移植 XNU 内核，并为处理器、内存、显示、触控和存储等硬件提供相应支持。公开仓库显示，项目目标平台为 QSD8250_LEO，采用 ARMv7 Thumb 架构。
其 GitHub 仓库名为“XNU Kernel and Board Support for HTC HD2”（基于 HTC-Leo-Revival-Project 的 XNU 代码库进行修改），其中包含针对 HD2 定制的 CPU、中断、定时器和内存映射代码，同时加入 SDCC 存储、MDP 显示输出以及 Type 2A 触控路径，并提供相应的 IOKit 显示和 HID 服务。
从项目说明来看，该仓库并不是可以直接刷入手机的完整固件包，而是以源代码为主。构建项目需要额外的 Darwin / Mach-O ARM 工具链、生成的 XNU 头文件以及匹配的目标配置。仓库没有包含 Apple 用户态组件、根文件系统、固件、启动镜像、SDK 或工具链二进制文件，因此不能将其简单理解为完整的 iOS 7 刷机包。
此次移植的核心之一是 XNU。XNU 是苹果用于 Darwin 系统的混合内核，也是 macOS 和 iOS 等苹果操作系统的内核基础，由 Mach 内核、FreeBSD 相关组件以及 IOKit 等部分组成。苹果目前仍公开维护 XNU 源代码，不过 32 位 ARM 相关支持已经属于历史平台范畴。
项目仓库还特别强调，当前的静态审计只能检查源文件路径以及本地头文件依赖关系，并不能证明代码已经能够完整编译、在 HTC HD2 上启动或稳定运行硬件。因此，虽然目前已经出现了 HTC HD2 运行 iOS 7 的实际演示，但开源仓库本身仍应被视为开发和移植项目，而非成熟的通用刷机方案。
IT之家注：HTC HD2 此前就因高度开放的启动环境和丰富的第三方系统移植历史而成为经典“万能机”。社区资料显示，这款手机过去已经出现过 Windows Phone、Android、Symbian 等多种非官方系统移植，而此次 iOS 7 项目则进一步将苹果移动操作系统带到了这款设备上。

units.text: 往年到了 9 月，iPhone、Apple Watch、AirPods 轮番登场，苹果一年中新品季也就到了高潮。没想到，今年 10 月的阵仗，看起来完全不输 9月——HomePad、新 HomePod mini、新 Apple TV、iPad mini 8，还有触屏 MacBook。
我的钱包还没缓过来，苹果已经开始下一轮了。
苹果新 CEO John Ternus 最近的动作，也颇有工程师出身的味道了，催产品开发进度，调整管理层级，还频繁出现在设计工作室里。
苹果产品接下来会变成什么样，看完这些新品已经初见端倪了。
苹果和 LG，连门铃、摄像头都安排上了
据彭博社报道，苹果正在与 LG 共同开发一系列智能家居配件，包括有线视频门铃、智能门锁、恒温器、温度传感器，以及室内、室外和泛光灯摄像头。
不过，你可能不会看到一把印着苹果标志的门锁。
据悉这批产品用的是 LG 品牌，制造和售后也由 LG 负责。 苹果参与共同开发，让它们与即将推出的家庭中枢、新 HomePod mini 和 Apple TV 配合工作。
这种合作其实有先例。当年苹果暂别外接显示器市场，就曾与 LG 共同开发 UltraFine 显示器。苹果用户买到了一台适配 Mac 的显示器，苹果也不用亲自包办所有事情。
如今，要接手这些活儿的产品，从桌上的显示器变成了家里的门铃和摄像头。
LG 智能门锁、恒温器的监管申报示意图
部分设备已经在监管资料里露面。多款配件支持 Wi-Fi、蓝牙、Thread 和 Matter，门锁还支持 UWB，可以实现靠近时自动解锁。
至于门锁怎么安装，室外摄像头如何经受风吹雨淋，坏了以后找谁维修，这些事情远比发布会上展示一套漂亮界面麻烦。让 LG 承担制造和服务，苹果就能更快补上过去缺少的设备。
毕竟，HomeKit 从 2014 年推出至今，已经走过十多年。Amazon Ring、Google Nest 早就把门铃和摄像头卖进了用户家里，苹果不能一直只提供一个“家庭”App，等着别人来填满它。
目前爆料称，苹果自家的家居设备计划在 10 月 13 日亮相，LG 这批配件则还要再等几个月才能买到。
HomePad 来了，Siri AI 进客厅
这些配件围绕的主角，就是传闻已久的家庭中枢，外界暂称它为 HomePad。
目前的消息指向一块约 6 英寸的方形触摸屏，既可以摆在桌上，也可以装到墙上。桌面款采用圆形金属底座加支臂的设计，看起来颇有一点 iMac G4 的意思。
播放音乐、打 FaceTime、查看日历、控制家居设备，都是它要承担的工作。
HomePad 概念图，非最终产品外观
带屏音箱，大家并不陌生。苹果要说服用户掏钱，免不了要先回答：家里淘汰下来的 iPad，不能干这些事吗？
爆料里有一组交互设计，倒是能看出苹果的想法。
人站得远的时候，屏幕只展示关键信息，当你走近之后再展开详细操作。它还可以识别不同的家庭成员，切换各自的日历、提醒等内容。
这就比给 HomePod 添一块屏幕复杂多了。iPad 通常跟着一个人的账号走，客厅里的设备却随时可能换人使用。私人设备上习以为常的消息通知，放到公共屏幕上，就得重新考虑怎么展示。
新版 Siri AI 也要在这里接受考验。它能否分清谁在发出指令，听懂连续的要求，再准确调用相应设备，会决定 HomePad 最后有多大用处。
毕竟，在客厅里对着一块屏幕重复三遍“关灯”，很难让人相信这是未来。
触屏 MacBook， macOS 提前准备好
另外，触屏 MacBook 这次估计真的要来了。
在最新的 macOS 27.2 测试版中，按住 Dock 里的应用图标，图标会稍稍放大，类似 iPhone 和 iPad 上的长按反馈。一个动画当然还不能坐实触屏 Mac，但放在这个时间点，很难不让人多想。
目前的消息指向两款定位更高的 14 英寸和 16 英寸笔记本，可能继续叫 MacBook Pro，也可能采用传闻中的 MacBook Ultra 名称，预计在 10 月或 11 月推出。
触控屏、双层 OLED、更薄的机身、灵动岛，大概就是这款产品最显著的更新。
对于每天背电脑通勤出差的人，有一个变化可能更有吸引力：减重。
Mark Gurman 提到，苹果重新安排了内部组件，并缩小部分零件，让新机“明显更轻”。到底轻多少，目前还没有数字，但 16 英寸 MacBook Pro 用户大概已经开始期待了。
芯片方面，最新爆料给出的仍是 M5 Pro 和 M5 Max。因此，这轮大改款有相当一部分看点，会落在屏幕和机身上。
触控则会给 macOS 出一道新题。过去为鼠标准备的菜单、按钮，手指点上去未必顺手；哪些操作适合直接碰屏幕，哪些仍该留给键盘和触控板，也需要重新琢磨。
iPad mini 8，小屏党终于等到 OLED
传闻中的 iPad mini 8，也准备换一块好屏幕了。
综合目前消息，新机有望采用 OLED 面板，收窄边框，同时换上 A20 Pro 芯片，内存从 8 GB 增加到 12 GB。前置摄像头也将调整位置，让横屏视频通话更自然。
喜欢 mini 的人，对它的要求往往很朴素。拿着轻松，出门塞进小包里也没负担，已经足以让他们放弃更大的屏幕。
可选择小尺寸，和想要更好的显示效果，并不冲突。
OLED 更深的黑色、更高的对比度，放在睡前看电影这样的场景里，很容易感受到差别。对坚持小尺寸的用户来说，这轮升级总算不用只盯着芯片型号看了。
其余更新可能还包括支持 Wi-Fi 7、蓝牙 6 的 N1 芯片，以及蜂窝版采用苹果自研调制解调器。
扬声器也可能重新设计，取消传统扬声器孔，采用新的发声结构。新机还有望首次获得 IP 防水等级，但目前尚不清楚能达到哪一级。
iPad mini 8 发布时间暂时指向 10 月，现款 iPad mini 在美国已经涨到 599 美元起，换用 OLED 后，新款很可能继续涨价。
苹果 CEO 的时间，开始更多地花在产品上
据 Gurman 报道，Ternus 现在每周都会数次走进设计工作室，亲自参与团队的工作，有时一天要去好几趟。库克过去通常至多每月到访一次，停留约一小时。
Ternus 深入参与的，包括工业设计和人机界面两支团队。Molly Anderson 和 Steve Lemay 分别负责日常带队，他本人则承担设计方面的最终决策。苹果目前也没有在寻找一位外部首席设计官来统筹这些工作。
经历了设计人才的持续流失，他还在通过提拔年轻设计师、从外部招聘，为团队补上空缺。亲自参与设计之外，他也在重新组织做设计的人。
为了腾出时间，财务工作更多交给 Kevan Parekh，供应链交给 Sabih Khan。他自己则频繁与硬件负责人合作，继续深入产品开发。
CEO 把时间花在哪里，一家公司就会把注意力放在哪里。
这种变化也延伸到了组织内部。Ternus 被曝希望减少工程师与高层之间的管理层级，鼓励更多实验，并降低对春秋集中发布的依赖，让团队在全年更频繁地推出新产品。相关改革仍在讨论和推进，改变这套运转多年的体系，可能需要数年。
当然，这批秋季新品经历了长期研发，当然不能都归功于 Ternus 上任一个多月的调整。但随着产品种类增加，苹果也会遇到更多需要跨团队做决定的问题。

如今，设计工作室成了他经常出现的地方。一个做硬件出身的 CEO，正在把自己熟悉的工作，重新放到掌舵苹果的日程里。
一家靠产品让人记住的公司，CEO 的座位，本来就该离样机近一点。
